Chapter 6977: Refined Into Mines

Chapter 6977: Refined Into Mines

Since the overlords shouted their displeasure, Li Qiye smiled: “Shut up if you don’t want to die.”

“You court death!” One overlord shouted.

“So be it.” Li Qiye became serious.

“Eat this!” The golden brick leaped forward, using its body as a weapon without any technique or dao power.

It had the immensity of a planet, using weight alone to attack.

“Bam!” The emperors and Tribulation Daoist were shocked to see this much power.

Unfortunately, it stopped right before smashing Li Qiye’s forehead. Something invisible seemed to be stopping it.

The brick didn’t give up and channeled all of its power. Deafening explosions quaked Survivor Realm to the inhabitants’ horror.

However, it couldn’t push any further.

“This is it?” Li Qiye shook his head and said: “I suppose this place is missing an ore mine.”

He raised his finger and something dreadful ensued - the overlord started melting into a golden liquid.

As it dripped into the ground, it drilled deeper and formed an underground mine. After all, the brick was an overlord - a being on the same level as Godfiend Monarch. A mine made from its essence could produce enough metals for eras to come.

“Ahh!” The brick bellowed in agony during the process. After all, it was still alive despite its form.

“How dare you?!” The other overlords attacked in unison.

“Rumble!” Survivor Realm faced an existential crisis due to the shockwaves.

Although the overlords’ attacks were simple, their effectiveness couldn’t be overstated.

The monastery’s members and living beings found this to be apocalyptic. Alas, Li Qiye smiled and said: “Leftover materials, nothing more.”

His gaze alone froze them in place, forcing them down to the ground. Moreover, they continued to sink before being converted into mines.

“Ahh!” They joined the golden brick in screaming.

In just a short time, the monastery gained five mines to benefit future generations.

“Stop!” Tile Immortal tried to reverse the process.

However, Li Qiye’s gaze forced it to stagger backward.

“Save us!” The five overlords bellowed but it was too late. The process was fully completed and they ceased to exist. If they had eyes, their eyes would be wide open in disbelief regarding their fate.
